units.source_text: 古歌：“悲无尽兮泪如河，人身之泪何其多！”

en.t: An old poem says, "Grief is endless, and tears flow like a river; how many tears the human body holds!"
It is found in The Six Books of Ancient and Modern Japanese Poetry.

units.source_text: 此处是由莲叶上的露珠联想眼泪。

en.t: Here, the dewdrops on lotus leaves call tears to mind.
